The New Shoes: 不合脚的新鞋带来的小麻烦。
Nina gets a pair of new shoes for her birthday. They are white with little stars. She loves them very much.
Nina wears the new shoes to school, but they are a little small. Her feet hurt. She does not tell anyone because she wants to wear the shoes so much.
After school, Nina walks home slowly. Mum sees her red feet and understands everything. Mum is not angry. She buys new shoes one size bigger, and the old ones go to Nina's little cousin.
